findings: '_' ID passes validation — toId('かっこいい モブ') returns '_', which is truthy and passes isValidId(), allowing the user to reach Step3 with an addon named _.mcaddon. Fix: guard check `suggestedId && suggestedId !== '_'` or add minimum-length check to isValidId.
Misleading test description — wizard.spec.ts test 'returns empty string for mixed Japanese + spaces' asserts toBe('_'), not ''. Rename to 'returns single underscore for Japanese text with spaces'.

Tab ARIA linkage missing — role="tab" buttons lack id attributes and role="tabpanel" uses aria-label instead of aria-labelledby. Add id="tab-{id}" to each tab and aria-labelledby="tab-{activeTab}" to the panel when implementing Status/Appearance tabs in Phase 3.
